data.creative: RV storage timeline: 48 hours to 90 days after the drop · 1119643240402494
data.hook: What happens inside your RV in the first 48 hours after you drop these pouches in will shock you.
data.desire: Open the RV in spring and find everything exactly how I left it, no droppings, no chewed wiring.
data.angle: RV sits unused all season; mice move into cabinets and wiring while you are away, and a rewiring bill waits.
data.belief_shift: from traps, poison and peppermint spray can't reach the hidden cavities of a rig → to four oils that spread into every gap and keep mice out the whole storage season
data.script_structure: curiosity hook (48 hours) → first hours: oils spread into gaps → four oils, four effects on the mouse → 48 hours: mice leave alive → week 1: gaps flooded, new mice turn around → 30 / 90 days: silent RV, no damage → product spec (65 sq ft, 90 days, no poison) → 60,000 users + Buy 2 Get 1 Free + guarantee → CTA
data.mechanism_reveal: Claim: castor oil 'makes every breath harder', cedarwood 'hits their nervous system and triggers a full panic response', peppermint 'blinds their sense of smell', cinnamon 'burns their airways'; mice 'leave alive because staying is no longer physically possible'. Soften: four strong plant scents mice avoid.
data.proof: Timeline visuals with green glowing 'fumes' animation (claimed effect, not real proof); 'Over 60,000 homeowners and RV owners' count claim near the end; 30-day money-back guarantee at the close; jar-of-mice shot at 1:23.
data.cta: Tap below before this deal ends. Buy 2 Get 1 Free with a 30-day money-back guarantee ('If you notice even a single sign of mice, you get every penny back').
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: The time-lapse structure (hours, days, 30, 90) keeps the viewer watching for the next milestone and maps neatly onto the RV storage season. Ending on 'the day you open that RV back up' pays off the owner's real fear of damage on reopening.
data.transferable_move: Tell what happens after first use as a timeline (first hours, 48 hours, week one, month three) inside the one place the buyer stores and worries about, ending on the moment they open it clean. Soften: describe what the owner notices, not panic, nerve or airway effects on the pest.
data.opening_visual: Covered travel trailer on a driveway with red text 'WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU DROP THIS IN YOUR RV', then a motorhome at a forest campsite.
data.transition_to_product: Pouch appears at 0:13 sitting on the RV floor with green vapor ('no trap'); bag shown at 1:05 ('from getting inside').
data.proof_placement: Mechanism animation follows the hook; count claim (60,000) follows the product spec; guarantee follows the offer.
